request_user:
Fact: additional_assets
What to find: Other assets released with the model (training data, training code, inference or evaluation code, checkpoints) and how to access them.
Card sections that often contain it: Model Sources, Resources, Links

Answer with status, value, quotes and section.

answer.value: The Molmo2 datasets are released and available via the Molmo2 data collection on Hugging Face (https://huggingface.co/collections/allenai/molmo2-data). Other artifacts (training code, evaluations, intermediate checkpoints) are not yet released and will be made available at a later date. Other Molmo2 family models are in the collection at https://huggingface.co/collections/allenai/molmo2.
quotes: Ai2 is commited to open science. The Molmo2 datasets are available [here](https://huggingface.co/collections/allenai/molmo2-data).

All other artifacts used in creating Molmo2 (training code, evaluations, intermediate checkpoints) will be made available at a later date, furthering our commitment to open-source AI development and reproducibility.
You can find all models in the Molmo2 family [here](https://huggingface.co/collections/allenai/molmo2).
